in_arabic.name: تسبيه
in_arabic.meaning: تعريف الله تعالى وتنزيهه عن كل نقص
in_arabic.long_meaning: تسبيه هو اسم مشتق من الفعل سبح، وهو يعني تعريف الله تعالى وتنزيهه عن كل نقص أو عيب. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الإسلام لوصف الله تعالى بأنه خالي من كل عيب أو نقص، وهو ما يتناسب مع مفهوم التنزيه الإلهي.

in_urdu.name: تسبیہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کی پاکی اور ستائش
in_urdu.long_meaning: تسبیہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل سبح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی ستائش کرنا اور اسے ہر قسم کی کمی یا نقص سے پاک قرار देना۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اللہ تعالیٰ کی پاکی اور اس کی عظمت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: तसबीह
in_hindi.long_meaning: तसबीह एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रिया सबह से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है भगवान की स्तुति करना और उसे किसी भी प्रकार की कमी या दोष से मुक्त घोषित करना। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में भगवान की पवित्रता और उसकी महानता को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: تسبیه
in_pashto.long_meaning: تسبیه د الله تعالیٰ د پاکۍ او ستاینې لپاره یو نوم دی، چی د عربی ژبې د سبح فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د الله تعالیٰ د عظمت او پاکۍ څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Tasbeeh
in_english.meaning: Glorification of Allah, declaration of His purity
in_english.long_meaning: Tasbeeh is a name derived from the Arabic verb 'sabaha,' which means to glorify, to declare the purity of Allah, and to exalt Him beyond any imperfections. In Islamic tradition, Tasbeeh signifies the act of acknowledging Allah's perfection and freedom from any defects. It reflects a deep spiritual significance, emphasizing the importance of praising and honoring Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The Tasbeeh is an essential practice in Islamic culture that involves the repetition of specific phrases to seek Allah's pleasure and blessings. These phrases are typically recited using a Tasbeeh bead or counter, known as Misbahah, to keep track of the number of repetitions. The practice of Tasbeeh is prevalent in various Islamic rituals, such as Salah (prayer), Dhikr (remembrance of Allah), and during times of need or hardship. It is also commonly practiced as a form of meditation or to seek clarity and focus.
data.spiritual_significance: The act of Tasbeeh holds great spiritual significance in Islam as it allows for the direct connection between the believer and Allah. Repeating the phrases of Tasbeeh serves as a reminder of Allah's presence, power, and mercy. It also encourages the worshipper to reflect on their actions and intentions and to seek forgiveness for their sins. Through this practice, the believer can cultivate a stronger relationship with Allah and increase their spiritual awareness and growth. Ultimately, Tasbeeh is a means to express gratitude and devotion to Allah and to seek His blessings and guidance in all aspects of life.
